_doc: Lynkk integrations film 'lynkk-orbit' (16 s, 30 fps, 120 BPM). Professional recordings only, credited in CREDITS.md. Built by real-sound scripts/mix.py from this file and one fragment per category in audio/design/. Client change: music is the lead element, loud and prominent; SFX sit inside it.
_buses_doc: v3 (new track): music is the clearly loudest element. -5 dB under the dark hook (0-2, the track is full-on from its first bar), 0 from the groove downbeat 2.0, +1.5 dB from the drop downbeat 10.0 (the loudest moment), held through the final hit at 14.0 which decays by itself. v3b: back to 0 dB on the 14.0 splice (the final beat measured -11.3 LUFS-M at 14.2, 0.3 LU over the drop).
_master_doc: -14 LUFS integrated, ceiling 0.77 linear (about -2.3 dBFS) so the AAC encode stays under -1 dBTP.
